title: autophage v1: watcher that fixes GitHub issues in a sandboxed agent
description: Design: docs/specs/2026-09-04-autophage-design.md, domain model, contracts, ADRs 0001 to 0006. Five plans under docs/plans/.

title: sandbox: disk quotas for workspaces and cache volumes, cache discard after a hostile attempt
description: Plan D final review, Important 7: memory, cpu and pids are bounded; disk is not. A looping agent can fill trig's disk from bash and take Postgres down with it, and /cache/go holds GOCACHE which the next attempt on the repository executes. Add a quota (xfs project quota or a sized volume) on the workspaces dir and the per-repository volumes, and a documented policy for discarding a repository's caches after a failed or hostile attempt.

title: sandbox: egress allowlist for the networked prep container
description: Plan D final review, Important 6: a lockfile committed by one attempt makes the next attempt's networked prep container fetch from attacker-chosen hosts (go direct VCS, npm resolved URLs, uv lock urls). Go is narrowed (proxy only, -mod=readonly). Add an egress allowlist (proxy.golang.org, registry.npmjs.org, pypi.org and files.pythonhosted.org) for the prep container, via a podman network with nftables rules or a forward proxy.

title: rookery: land init.sh fixes and follow-ups
description: Branch fix/init-gitignore-and-bd-hook in a scratch clone (two commits: bd init hooksPath deadlock on macOS, .gitignore /app rewrite). Follow-ups found: web/index.html id=app rewrite breaks SPA mount; bd init sweeps staged renames into its own commit and replaces the AGENTS.md symlink; cosmetic app leftovers; init.sh does not gofmt after the module rename (import block left unsorted, make check fails on a fresh scaffold).

title: sandbox: warm-deps errors on pnpm repos without packageManager; hardening test lacks :z and :Z assertions; lease note in port doc
description: Plan D final re-review residual minors. (1) deploy/warm-deps runs corepack prepare --activate whenever pnpm-lock.yaml exists; without a packageManager field it errors and the healthy repo logs done with failures. Guard on the field. (2) podman_test.go hardening test asserts neither the :z cache mounts nor -v <ws>:/work:Z, so the SELinux half of the fix has no Mac regression test. (3) image_test.sh AGENT_FLAGS omits -e GOPROXY=off -e GOFLAGS=-mod=mod that podman.go passes. (4) Port doc: Workspace.lease is unexported; a Workspace rebuilt by hand or persisted across a restart carries a nil lease and Teardown releases nothing. (5) Containers started before db8811d carry no autophage.workspace label and are not swept: one-time rollout note for trig. (6) A second successful CommitAndPush in one attempt is refused as stale; the contracts row should say called once.

title: api: run approves a case whose issue closed before the delivery landed
description: Operator run on an existing case does not re-read GitHub, so it approves an issue already closed upstream; the closing delivery closes it moments later.

title: app: Listen goroutine is not joined on shutdown
description: Dispatcher.Run cancels the listen context and returns without waiting for Store.Listen to unwind.

title: app: reword the outcome comment call to action
description: OutcomeBody ends every comment with add the label to run again with the larger budget, which reads wrong after a Failed{Infra} that had nothing to do with budget and after an approved attempt already on the larger one.

title: app: Recovery only runs at boot
description: An attempt orphaned while the daemon is up waits for a restart; the floor sweep could reap it.

title: app: enqueueOutcome is silent on an unmatched attempt id
description: The loop falls through and returns nil when no attempt matches, so the outcome comment is dropped without a word.

title: github: label-before-open race needs two translators to reach
description: The create-then-conflict path in the label branch is only reachable with concurrent translators, so no test drives it.

title: github: MintToken Expiry fallback is unreachable
description: The 55-minute default cannot be hit through the current transport, and token plus expiry are read under two lock acquisitions.

title: github: all ValidatePayload failures map to 401
description: A malformed body and a wrong signature are both unauthenticated; the malformed one is invalid_request.

title: store: drop the vestigial _ = time.Now in deliveries_test
description: Left over from the brief's text; the import is used elsewhere in the file.

title: store: no concurrent double-enqueue test for the comment outbox
description: EnqueueTriageComment and EnqueueOutcomeComment check-then-insert; two sweeps racing is untested.

title: store: cover AssignID refusals and sub-second intervals
description: AssignID's empty and already-assigned refusals are untested, and no test round-trips a sub-second INTERVAL.

title: store: Listen backoff never resets after a healthy stretch
description: A long-lived connection that later drops resumes at the last backoff instead of starting over.

title: store: RemoveRepository notifies for an unknown repository
description: The insert-select writes nothing when the repository is unknown but the notify fires anyway, waking a pointless sweep.

title: resolution: Outcome.cause CauseClosed fallback is unreachable
description: The final return in cause() cannot be hit now that RecordOutcome validates the reason first; drop it or prove it.

title: resolution: BuildBrief does not validate Repository
description: BuildBrief takes a zero Repository without complaint, and OwnerName trusts FullName has a slash.

title: resolution: cover target() attempt id mismatch
description: RecordRun and RecordOutcome refuse an attemptID that is not the open attempt; no test names that path.

title: resolution: cache Parse<Name> candidate slices
description: Every ParseX call rebuilds its candidate slice; hoist each to a package-level var.
